A new Dendro Elemental Resonance, "Sprawling Greenery", raises Elemental Mastery and rewards triggering several of those reactions. This is a gameplay summary, not in-world lore.

key: Through Mists of Smoke and Forests Dark
108.comment: Version 3.0: The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings: Through Mists of Smoke and Forests Dark
108.content: Chapter III Act I is the opening of the Sumeru story. The Traveler and Paimon, seeking the Dendro Archon, meet Tighnari and Collei in the rainforest and follow a stolen Akademiya object toward Sumeru City.

109.comment: Version 3.0: The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings: Dendro element release
109.content: Dendro was introduced in Version 3.0 as the seventh playable element. The Traveler could take it as a new element, and the new Dendro Elemental Resonance and Bloom and Catalyze reactions were added.

110.comment: Version 3.0: The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings: Version 3.0 events
110.content: New limited-time events were Graven Innocence, Fayz Trials, Tablet Analytics, Lost Riches and a Ley Line Overflow. They are gameplay events, known only to people who played them.

key: Version 3.1: King Deshret and the Three Magi
King Deshret and the Three Magi version
111.comment: Version 3.1: King Deshret and the Three Magi
111.content:
Version 3.1: King Deshret and the Three Magi (also: Version 3.1, King Deshret and the Three Magi version, Genshin Impact 3.1, Sumeru desert release): Version 3.1, "King Deshret and the Three Magi", was released on 2022-09-28. It opened the desert half of Sumeru, the Great Red Sand, and continued Archon Quest Chapter III with Acts III and IV. It added the playable characters Cyno, Nilou and Candace.

It follows Version 3.0 and precedes Version 3.2. Where 3.0 was the rainforest and the Akademiya's world of scholars, 3.1 turned to the desert people, the Eremites, and the buried history of King Deshret.

Release: Released 2022-09-28, between Version 3.0 and Version 3.2.

Phase I (2022-09-28) had the banners Twilight Arbiter (Cyno and Candace) and Ballad in Goblets (Venti and Candace). Phase II (2022-10-14) had Twirling Lotus (Nilou) and Secretum Secretorum (Albedo).

Characters: Cyno ("Judicator of Secrets", 5-star Electro polearm), Nilou ("Dance of Lotuslight", 5-star Hydro sword) and Candace ("Golden Vow", 4-star Hydro polearm) joined the game.

Cyno and Candace appear in the Archon Quest acts of this version; Nilou's role was already set up in Act II of 3.0 and carried into her Story Quest, Lotos Somno Chapter Act I, "To the Wise".

Quests: Archon Quest Chapter III Act III is "Dreams, Emptiness, Deception" and Act IV is "King Deshret and the Three Magi". Cyno's Story Quest Lupus Aureus Chapter Act I, "Sands of Solitude", and Nilou's Lotos Somno Chapter Act I, "To the Wise", also arrived.

112.comment: Version 3.1: King Deshret and the Three Magi: Great Red Sand
112.content: The new area was Sumeru's desert, the Great Red Sand, with three listed subareas: the Hypostyle Desert, the Land of Lower Setekh and the Land of Upper Setekh. It added desert wildlife such as scorpions, desert foxes and scarabs, and enemies such as Aeonblight Drakes, Primal Constructs and Eremite types.

key: King Deshret and the Three Magi
113.comment: Version 3.1: King Deshret and the Three Magi: Chapter III Acts III and IV
113.content: Act III begins after the Sabzeruz samsara: the Traveler and Nahida plan to turn the Grand Sage's secretary, the Fatui Harbinger Dottore springs a trap, and the trail leads to Aaru Village in the desert, where Alhaitham, Cyno, Dehya and Candace meet. In Act IV, missing Village Keepers lead the group to the ruins of King Deshret's civilisation, where an inscription recalls how forbidden knowledge harmed his people and how Greater Lord Rukkhadevata helped them.

114.comment: Version 3.1: King Deshret and the Three Magi: Version 3.1 events
114.content: New limited-time events were Of Ballads and Brews, Wind Chaser, Star-Seeker's Sojourn, Hyakunin Ikki, Path of Gleaming Jade and a thank-you gift event. The permanent Spiral Abyss challenge Curtain of Leaves, which lets players invite Collei, came with the version.

115.comment: Version 3.1: King Deshret and the Three Magi: Spiral Abyss changes in 3.1
115.content: Gameplay note: Floor 11 gave every party member a 75 percent Electro damage bonus, and the lunar phases that began after the update were Pruning Moon, Ascending Moon and Rupturing Moon, which rewarded Bloom, Hyperbloom and Burgeon and Dendro Core damage. This is game mechanics, not in-world lore.

key: Version 3.2: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises
Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises version
116.comment: Version 3.2: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises
116.content:
Version 3.2: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises (also: Version 3.2, Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises version, Genshin Impact 3.2, Nahida release): Version 3.2, "Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises", was released on 2022-11-02. It brought Sumeru's Archon Quest, Chapter III, to its conclusion with Act V, and added the playable characters Nahida and Layla. It opened no new region.

It follows Version 3.1 and precedes Version 3.3. The version tagline describes a classified Akademiya project, carried out by the collective effort of the Six Darshans, approaching its final stage with an outcome that "is not up to them to decide".

Release: Released 2022-11-02, between Version 3.1 and Version 3.3.

Phase I (2022-11-02) had The Moongrass' Enlightenment (Nahida) and Tapestry of Golden Flames (Yoimiya). Phase II (2022-11-18) had Everbloom Violet (Yae Miko and Layla) and Farewell of Snezhnaya (Tartaglia and Layla).

Characters: Nahida ("Physic of Purity", a 5-star Dendro catalyst user) and Layla ("Fantastical Evening Star", a 4-star Cryo sword user) joined the game.

Layla's Hangout Event, Act I, "Ever Silent Stars", arrived in Version 3.6; Layla could also be invited to the party through the Version 3.8 event Secret Summer Paradise.

Quests: Archon Quest Chapter III Act V is "Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises". World Quests were "Next Time, On King of Invokations..." and the now-accessible "The Gourmet Supremos: Cleanup". The Serenitea Pot gained its Replication system.

key: Akasha Pulses the Kalpa Flame Rises
117.comment: Version 3.2: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises: Chapter III Act V revelations
117.content: In Act V the Traveler and Sumeru's allies free Nahida from the Akasha and enter it with her. She takes the Electro Gnosis from Scaramouche, who had been made into a false god, and she and the Traveler reach Rukkhadevata's last memory. There Rukkhadevata tells her that saving Irminsul requires erasing her, and the forbidden knowledge is removed.

118.comment: Version 3.2: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises: Version 3.2 events
118.content: Limited events were Fabulous Fungus Frenzy, Adventurer's Trials, Hypostatic Symphony: Dissonant Verse, Outside the Canvas, Inside the Lens: Greenery Chapter, and Marvelous Merchandise.

119.comment: Version 3.2: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises: Spiral Abyss changes in 3.2
119.content: Gameplay note: Floor 11 raised every party member's Elemental Mastery by 200, and the lunar phases were Hailing Moon and Lush Moon. This is game mechanics, not in-world lore.

key: Version 3.3: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void
All Senses Clear, All Existence Void version
120.comment: Version 3.3: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void
120.content:
Version 3.3: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void (also: Version 3.3, All Senses Clear, All Existence Void version, Genshin Impact 3.3, Genius Invokation TCG release): Version 3.3, "All Senses Clear, All Existence Void", was released on 2022-12-07. It added Act III of the Interlude Chapter of the Archon Quests, "Inversion of Genesis", the card game Genius Invokation TCG, and the playable characters Wanderer and Faruzan. It opened no new region.

It follows Version 3.2 and precedes Version 3.4. The Interlude act is a Sumeru story, while the event content of the version was Inazuman: the tagline speaks of kaidan and legends about Inazuma and its long-lived youkai.

Release: Released 2022-12-07, between Version 3.2 and Version 3.4.

Phase I had From Ashes Reborn (Wanderer and Faruzan) and Oni's Royale (Arataki Itto and Faruzan). Phase II had Reign of Serenity (Raiden Shogun) and Azure Excursion (Kamisato Ayato).

Characters: The Wanderer ("Eons Adrift", a 5-star Anemo catalyst user) and Faruzan ("Enigmatic Machinist", a 4-star Anemo bow user) joined the game.

Faruzan's Hangout Event is covered in the archive as a quest entry. Both characters use Anemo.

Quests: The Archon Quest content is Interlude Chapter Act III, "Inversion of Genesis". Commissions were "The Day the Sword Departs" and "Where Is the Unseen Razor?". World Quests included "Battlefield of Dice, Cats, and Cards", which introduced the card game through "Come Try Genius Invokation TCG!", and the Ascension Challenges I to IV.

121.comment: Version 3.3: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void: Genius Invokation TCG
121.content: Genius Invokation TCG, a collectible card game played with elemental dice, arrived as new gameplay in Version 3.3. It is a gameplay system rather than an in-world story, though the characters on the cards are the game's roster.

122.comment: Version 3.3: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void: Inversion of Genesis
122.content: In this act the Traveler and Paimon, visiting Sumeru, overhear two scholars researching a legend about the Tatarasuna incident, which includes a puppet-like kabukimono. They follow Scaramouche into the Sanctuary of Surasthana and learn that Nahida made a deal with him to investigate Irminsul on her behalf. He had been discarded by Dottore and the other Harbingers after his defeat. At his request the Traveler picks a new name for him, and he asks the Traveler to tell the Raiden Gokaden's descendants that he was responsible for their downfall.

123.comment: Version 3.3: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void: Version 3.3 events
123.content: Limited events were Akitsu Kimodameshi, Across the Wilderness, Windtrace and Misty Dungeon: Realm of Sand, plus a Ley Line Overflow. The permanent domain City of Gold was added.

124.comment: Version 3.3: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void: Spiral Abyss changes in 3.3
124.content: Gameplay note: Floor 11 gave all characters a 75 percent Anemo damage bonus, and the lunar phases were Terminal Moon, Breezecall Moon and Supreme Moon. This is game mechanics, not in-world lore.

125.content:
Version 3.4: The Exquisite Night Chimes (also: Version 3.4, The Exquisite Night Chimes version, Genshin Impact 3.4, Desert of Hadramaveth release): Version 3.4, "The Exquisite Night Chimes", was released on 2023-01-18. It added the Desert of Hadramaveth, a desert region of Sumeru, and the flagship Lantern Rite event that gave the version its name. It added the playable characters Alhaitham and Yaoyao and had no Archon Quest.

It follows Version 3.3 and precedes Version 3.5. The story focus of the update is therefore split: desert World Quests and a character Story Quest in Sumeru, and a Liyue-set festival event.

Release: Released 2023-01-18, between Version 3.3 and Version 3.5.

Phase I had Caution in Confidence (Alhaitham and Yaoyao) and Invitation to Mundane Life (Xiao and Yaoyao). Phase II had Moment of Bloom (Hu Tao) and Discerner of Enigmas (Yelan).

Characters: Alhaitham ("Admonishing Instruction", a 5-star Dendro sword user) and Yaoyao ("Burgeoning Grace", a 4-star Dendro polearm user) joined the game.

Alhaitham's Story Quest, Vultur Volans Chapter Act I, "The Illusions of the Mob", arrived with the version.

Quests: There was no Archon Quest. New World Quest chains included Apocalypse Lost, "Her Foes Rage Like Great Waters...", The Dirge of Bilqis, and the single quests "Rejoice With Me, for What Was Lost Is Now Found", "Tadhla the Falcon", "The Falcon's Hunt" and "The Fallen Falcon".

Desert of hadramaveth: The new area was the Desert of Hadramaveth in Sumeru. Its listed subareas include the Tanit Camps, Debris of Panjvahe, Dunes of Steel, Mt. Damavand, Passage of Ghouls, Qusayr Al-Inkhida', The Sands of Al-Azif, The Sands of Three Canals, Safhe Shatranj, Wadi Al-Majuj and Wounded Shin Valley.

126.comment: Version 3.4: The Exquisite Night Chimes: The Exquisite Night Chimes
126.content: The Exquisite Night Chimes was the Version 3.4 flagship event and ran 2023-01-19 to 2023-02-06. It required Adventure Rank 28 and the Archon Quest "A New Star Approaches". Players took part in four themed challenges, Radiant Sparks, Paper Theater, Vigilance at Sea and Behind the Scenes, and could invite a chosen 4-star Liyue character to the party.

127.comment: Version 3.4: The Exquisite Night Chimes: Version 3.4 system changes
127.content: Gameplay note: Genius Invokation TCG gained a casual Heated Battle Mode and match history, new Beidou and Klee cards were added, and the Tree of Dreams in Vanarana had its level cap raised to 40. Floor 11 of the Spiral Abyss gave a 75 percent Dendro damage bonus, and the lunar phases were Thorn-Twisted Moon, Verdant Moon and Luxuriant Moon.

128.content:
Version 3.5: Windblume's Breath (also: Version 3.5, Patch 3.5, 3.5 update, Windblume's Breath update): Version 3.5, "Windblume's Breath", was released on 2023-03-01, after Version 3.4. It added Dehya and Mika, the Windblume's Breath festival event in Mondstadt and Archon Quest Chapter III Act VI. It opened no new region.

The Archon Quest Act, "Caribert", has the Traveler and Dainsleif meet Kaeya in Sumeru and then investigate a hut in Avidya Forest. Dehya's first Story Quest and a Hangout Event for Faruzan also arrived.

Release: Released 2023-03-01. Previous: 3.4. Next: 3.6.

New characters: Dehya (5-star Pyro claymore, "Flame-Mane") and Mika (4-star Cryo polearm, "Coordinates of Clear Frost"). New weapons: Beacon of the Reed Sea (5-star claymore) and Mailed Flower (4-star claymore).

New content: Dehya and Mika. Archon Quest Chapter III Act VI, "Caribert". Event: Windblume's Breath.

Story Quest: Mantichora Chapter Act I, "Lionsblood" (Dehya). Hangout Event, Series VIII: Faruzan, Act I, "A Confounding Conundrum".

129.comment: Version 3.5: Windblume's Breath: Version 3.5 Windblume's Breath event
129.content: This flagship event ran from 2023-03-03 to 2023-03-20 (shop to 2023-03-27) and needed Adventure Rank 18 and Prologue Act III, "Song of the Dragon and Freedom". Its weapon reward was Mailed Flower. The story, "Windblume Encounters", has three parts: A Gathering of Outlanders, A Riddle Amidst the Crowds and Joy Above the Clouds.

130.content: "Lionsblood" is the first Act of Dehya's Story Quest, the Mantichora Chapter. It needs Adventure Rank 40 and the Archon Quest "Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises". It has three quests: Shade Upon Red Silk, Annals of the Scarlet Sands and Sincerity's Facade.

131.content: "Caribert" is the sixth Act of Chapter III and needs Adventure Rank 35. Its four quests are Destined Encounter, Fortune-Mocking Pedigree, A Lamenter at Fate's End and Portended Fate. The Traveler and Dainsleif meet Kaeya in Port Ormos and then search the forest for a place Dainsleif remembers from his time with the Traveler's sibling.

132.content:
Version 3.6: A Parade of Providence (also: Version 3.6, A Parade of Providence version, Genshin Impact 3.6, Girdle of the Sands release): Version 3.6, "A Parade of Providence", was released on 2023-04-12. It opened two new areas in Sumeru's Girdle of the Sands, Gavireh Lajavard and the Realm of Farakhkert, and ran the flagship Akademiya event of the same name. Baizhu and Kaveh were added as playable characters in the second half of the version. There was no Archon Quest.

It follows Version 3.5 and precedes Version 3.7. The tagline reflects on joy and sorrow as constant companions and on history as a long river that never stops flowing.

Release: Released 2023-04-12, between Version 3.5 and Version 3.7.

Phase I had reruns of The Moongrass' Enlightenment (Nahida) and Twirling Lotus (Nilou). Phase II had Immaculate Pulse (Baizhu and Kaveh) and Adrift in the Harbor (Ganyu and Kaveh).

Characters: Baizhu ("Beyond Mortality", a 5-star Dendro catalyst user, owner of Bubu Pharmacy) and Kaveh ("Empyrean Reflection", a 4-star Dendro claymore user, a Sumeru architect) were the new playable characters.

Baizhu's Story Quest is the Lagenaria Chapter, Act I, "The Heart of Healing". Nahida's Sapientia Oromasdis Chapter Act II, "Homecoming", and Layla's Hangout Event Act I, "Ever Silent Stars", also arrived.

Quests: There was no Archon Quest. World Quests included "An Artist Adrift", "Another Home There May Yet Be", "Heart of Amrita", "Lightcall Resonance", and the chains Khvarena of Good and Evil, Monumental Study and Pale Fire.

133.comment: Version 3.6: A Parade of Providence: Gavireh Lajavard and Realm of Farakhkert
133.content: Two new areas, Gavireh Lajavard and the Realm of Farakhkert, were added to the Girdle of the Sands in Sumeru. The wiki lists shared exploration features including Fravashi Trees, Amrita Mayflies and Khvarena Inscription Fragments.

134.comment: Version 3.6: A Parade of Providence: A Parade of Providence
134.content: A Parade of Providence was the flagship event, held during the Akademiya Extravaganza and running 2023-04-27 to 2023-05-15, with its three story acts unlocking across the first days. It required Adventure Rank 30 and the Archon Quest "A New Star Approaches". Completing the Darshans' games filled a Gala Excitement meter, and enough of it invited Faruzan to the party.

135.comment: Version 3.6: A Parade of Providence: Version 3.6 system changes
135.content: Gameplay note: the Tree of Dreams level cap rose to 50 and Dendro Sigils could be exchanged with Khalid. Genius Invokation TCG gained Arataki Itto, Kamisato Ayato and Tighnari cards and a duel replay function. Floor 11 of the Spiral Abyss gave a 75 percent Dendro damage bonus, and the lunar phases were Reverberating Moon, Erupting Moon and Flourishing Moon.

136.content:
Version 3.7: Duel! The Summoners' Summit! (also: Version 3.7, Duel! The Summoners' Summit! (version), 3.7 update): Version 3.7, Duel! The Summoners' Summit!, was released on 2023-05-24. It introduced Kirara and a large Genius Invokation TCG update with a TCG-themed flagship event. It had no Archon Quest and no new region.

The flagship event, the King of Invokations Grand Prix, centres on the card game. The version blurb compares a card game to life: fortune deals the hand, but experience can shift the odds.

Characters and banners: Kirara ("Cat Upon the Eaves") is a 4-star Dendro sword user. Phase I banners were Tapestry of Golden Flames (Yoimiya and Kirara) and Everbloom Violet (Yae Miko and Kirara); phase II, from 2023-06-13, was Leaves in the Wind (Kaedehara Kazuha) and Caution in Confidence (Alhaitham). The new weapon was Ibis Piercer, a 4-star bow.

How {{char}} behaves: A 3.7 scene is a lighthearted one in which characters play a card game, so use it for casual conversations, not for lore. Kirara is a newcomer here; treat Luozi, Takugen and Dunia as event characters.

137.comment: Version 3.7: Duel! The Summoners' Summit!: Version 3.7
137.content: Version 3.7 (2023-05-24) introduced Kirara and the Genius Invokation TCG-themed event Duel! The Summoners' Summit!, with new TCG modes and cards. It had no Archon Quest.

138.content:
Version 3.8: Secret Summer Paradise (also: Version 3.8, Secret Summer Paradise version, Genshin Impact 3.8): Version 3.8, "Secret Summer Paradise", was released on 2023-07-05. It is a summer update centred on the limited-time area Veluriyam Mirage, a domain inside a bottle that the Traveler visits during the flagship event of the same name. It added no Archon Quest and no new playable characters.

It sits between Version 3.7 and Version 4.0, the last update before the game moved on to Fontaine. The event reward was the already-released Cryo character Layla, who could be invited to the party by collecting event currency.

Release: Released 2023-07-05, between Version 3.7 and Version 4.0.

Banner phases reran Eula and Klee in Phase I, and Sangonomiya Kokomi and the Wanderer in Phase II. New outfits were Klee's Blossoming Starlight and Kaeya's Sailwind Shadow.

Veluriyam mirage: The limited-time area was called the Veluriyam Mirage, colloquially Bottleland. Official text describes it as a quiet, beautiful domain hidden inside a bottle, home to special Hydro life-forms, and as a rumoured desert domain that grants the heart's desire to those who enter. The same text asks whether the crowd of travellers filling the bottle is nothing but a mirage.

Event: Secret Summer Paradise ran from 2023-07-05 to 2023-08-16 and was a flagship event. Its story had three acts (An Invitation From Afar!, Mirage Paradise in Crisis!, Dreams and First Encounters!) and four gameplay modes: Spino Blaster, Sojourns of the Barking Fox, Dance of Flashing Thought and Bing-Bang Finchball. It required Adventure Rank 18 and the Archon Quest Song of the Dragon and Freedom.

Quests: New quests were the Kaeya Hangout Event Act I, "Shenanigans and Sweet Wine"; the World Quests "Purbiruni's Commandment" and "Recollections of a Fontainian"; and the limited-time World Quests "A Starry Night, as Remembered", "Daiya's Three-Day Reverie", "Returning Curios" and "Capturing Light and Shadow".

139.comment: Version 3.8: Secret Summer Paradise: Secret Summer Paradise
139.content: Secret Summer Paradise is the Version 3.8 flagship summer event. The Traveler and Paimon return to the Knights of Favonius headquarters and learn of a special adventure, which leads to the Veluriyam Mirage, a bottle domain. Layla was the character reward.

key: Version 4.0: As Light Rain Falls Without Reason
140.comment: Version 4.0: As Light Rain Falls Without Reason
140.content:
Version 4.0: As Light Rain Falls Without Reason (also: Version 4.0, Genshin Impact 4.0, 4.0 update): Version 4.0, "As Light Rain Falls Without Reason", was released on 2023-08-16. It opened Fontaine, the Hydro nation, as a playable region and started Archon Quest Chapter IV. It added the characters Lyney, Lynette and Freminet and gave the Traveler the Hydro element.

The story is a run of public trials in the Court of Fontaine: first a death and disappearance at the Opera Epiclese, then Navia's hunt for whoever is behind a series of vanishings of young women.

New content: New characters: Lyney (5-star Pyro Bow), Lynette (4-star Anemo Sword) and Freminet (4-star Cryo Claymore). New region: Fontaine, with the Belleau Region, Beryl Region and Court of Fontaine Region. The Traveler can now be Hydro.

New weapon on the weapon banner: The First Great Magic (5-star Bow). New artifact sets: Golden Troupe and Marechaussee Hunter. New systems: Arkhe (the Pneuma and Ousia energies), diving, the Fountain of Lucine and the Fontaine reputation system. New enemy families include Clockwork Meka, Fontemer Aberrants, Tainted Hydro Phantasms and Breacher Primuses.

Story: Archon Quest Chapter IV, Act I (Prelude of Blancheur and Noirceur) and Act II (As Light Rain Falls Without Reason).

In Act I the Traveler and Paimon reach Romaritime Harbor, meet Lyney and Lynette, and hear the prophecy that Fontaine will be flooded and its people washed of their sin. At the twins' opera performance a trick goes wrong, a stagehand is found dead and an audience member vanishes. Lyney is tried, the Traveler defends him, and the twins' Fatui membership comes out in court.

Characters introduced: Lyney and Lynette are magician siblings of the House of the Hearth, and Freminet is their shy younger brother. Navia (head of Spina di Rosula), Clorinde (the Champion Duelist) and Charlotte (a reporter) become the Traveler's allies in the Archon Quest. Neuvillette is chief justice of the Court and Furina is Fontaine's public Archon.

Placement: Follows 3.8 and precedes 4.1.

Version 4.0 is the first version with Fontaine content, so any scene set in Fontaine under the Archon Quest begins here.

key: Version 4.1: To the Stars Shining in the Depths
141.comment: Version 4.1: To the Stars Shining in the Depths
141.content:
Version 4.1: To the Stars Shining in the Depths (also: Version 4.1, Genshin Impact 4.1, 4.1 update): Version 4.1, "To the Stars Shining in the Depths", was released on 2023-09-27. It added Wriothesley (5-star Cryo Catalyst) and Neuvillette (5-star Hydro Catalyst) and continued Fontaine's Archon Quest with Acts III and IV.

Both acts take place largely in the Fortress of Meropide, the underwater prison that Wriothesley administers. The search for the missing Childe leads to a failing sluice gate that holds back the Primordial Sea.

New content: New areas: the Liffey Region and the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region. New weapons: Tome of the Eternal Flow and Cashflow Supervision (both 5-star Catalysts).

Banners ran as Decree of the Deeps (Neuvillette), Moment of Bloom (Hu Tao), Tempestuous Destiny (Wriothesley) and Ballad in Goblets (Venti). Four-star weapons were The Dockhand's Assistant, Portable Power Saw, Prospector's Drill, Range Gauge and Ballad of the Boundless Blue.

Story: Archon Quest Chapter IV, Act III (To the Stars Shining in the Depths) and Act IV (Cataclysm's Quickening).

Childe has vanished from the Fortress of Meropide, so Neuvillette arranges for the Traveler and Paimon to be sentenced on false charges to 45 days there and investigate quietly. Inside, they meet the administrator Wriothesley, the head nurse Sigewinne and the prison's strange "hidden rules", and they find that Lyney, Lynette and Freminet are also looking for Childe. Freminet nearly dies from Primordial Seawater in the flooded tunnel Childe used.

Characters introduced: Wriothesley is the administrator of the Fortress of Meropide, called the Duke. Neuvillette is the chief justice of Fontaine. Sigewinne is the prison's head nurse. Wriothesley first appears in this version; Neuvillette was already seen in 4.0.

Placement: Follows 4.0 and precedes 4.2.

Act III picks up days after the Act II verdicts. The Fortress of Meropide, the sluice gate and Neuvillette's identity are 4.1 reveals and are not known to anyone who has only seen 4.0.

142.content:
Version 4.2: Masquerade of the Guilty (also: Version 4.2, Genshin Impact 4.2, 4.2 update): Version 4.2, "Masquerade of the Guilty", was released on 2023-11-08. It added Furina (5-star Hydro Sword) and Charlotte (4-star Cryo Catalyst) and the Archon Quest finale of Fontaine's prophecy, Chapter IV Act V.

Act V is a trial of the Hydro Archon: Furina is put in the dock and found guilty of not being the Archon. The act then reveals what the prophecy actually meant and ends with the sacrifice of the true Archon Focalors.

New content: New areas: the Erinnyes Forest and the Morte Region. New weapons: Splendor of Tranquil Waters (5-star Sword) and Sword of Narzissenkreuz (4-star Sword).

Banners ran as Chanson of Many Waters (Furina and Charlotte), Immaculate Pulse (Baizhu and Charlotte), Twilight Arbiter (Cyno) and Azure Excursion (Kamisato Ayato). Furina's Story Quest, Animula Choragi Chapter Act I - "The Little Oceanid", arrived this version.

Story: Archon Quest Chapter IV, Act V: Masquerade of the Guilty.

After the Poisson flood, which dissolves people on the lower levels, including Navia's companions Melus and Silver, the Traveler helps Neuvillette force Furina onto the stage of the Opera Epiclese. The Traveler prosecutes her as a fraud, and when diluted Primordial Seawater affects her like any Fontainian, she is judged not to be the Hydro Archon. Yet the Oratrice still returns a death sentence for the Hydro Archon.

Characters introduced: Furina is Fontaine's celebrated public Archon and, as Act V shows, a human who has played that role for five centuries. Charlotte is a reporter for the Steambird who has appeared since 4.0 and became playable here. Focalors, the true Archon, appears only briefly.

Placement: Follows 4.1 and precedes 4.3.

Act V closes the Fontaine Archon Quest apart from the epilogue (Act VI) released in 4.7. Anything that treats Furina as a god is set before the end of Act V.

143.content:
Version 4.3: Roses and Muskets (also: Version 4.3, Genshin Impact 4.3, 4.3 update): Version 4.3, "Roses and Muskets", was released on 2023-12-20. It added Navia (5-star Geo Claymore) and Chevreuse (4-star Pyro Polearm). It has no new region and no Archon Quest.

Its centrepiece is the limited-time Fontinalia film-festival event. The version follows the Archon Quest finale of 4.2 and has no main-story chapter of its own.

New content: New weapons: Verdict (5-star Claymore) and Ultimate Overlord's Mega Magic Sword (4-star Claymore, an event reward). New artifact sets: Nighttime Whispers in the Echoing Woods and Song of Days Past.

Banners ran as In the Name of the Rosula (Navia), The Heron's Court (Kamisato Ayaka), Reign of Serenity (Raiden Shogun and Chevreuse) and Tapestry of Golden Flames (Yoimiya and Chevreuse). Navia's Story Quest, Rosa Multiflora Chapter Act I - Braving the Tides Together, arrived this version.

Event: Roses and Muskets was a flagship event, running from 2023-12-21 to 2024-01-08, with its shop open until 2024-01-15.

The Traveler and Paimon join the Fontinalia Film Festival. The filmmaker Xavier loses an investor and the group, including Chiori, Ayaka, Ayato and Yoimiya, recruit Furina as director for a film of "The Two Musketeers" and consult Chevreuse on muskets. Its four story acts were followed by an afterword.

Placement: Follows 4.2 and precedes 4.4.

The event is a limited-time story, so characters should know of it only if they took part or heard about it.

key: Version 4.4: Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze
144.comment: Version 4.4: Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze
144.content:
Version 4.4: Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze (also: Version 4.4, Genshin Impact 4.4): Version 4.4, "Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze", was released on 2024-01-31. It opened Chenyu Vale, a new mountain-and-river area of Liyue, and added Xianyun (5-star Anemo Catalyst) and Gaming (4-star Pyro Claymore). It had no Archon Quest.

The new area centres on tea-growing settlements such as Qiaoying Village and the port of Yilong Wharf, and ties into old Liyue adepti stories.

Contents: New characters: Xianyun ("Passerine Herald", 5-star Anemo Catalyst) and Gaming ("Leonine Vanguard", 4-star Pyro Claymore). New weapon: Crane's Echoing Call (5-star Catalyst). New area: Chenyu Vale, with Chenyu Vale: Upper Vale, Chenyu Vale: Southern Mountain and Mt. Laixin. Event wishes: The Crane Soars Skyward (Xianyun and Gaming) and The Moongrass' Enlightenment (Nahida and Gaming) in phase I; Invitation to Mundane Life (Xiao) and Everbloom Violet (Yae Miko) in phase II.

Story: Chenyu Vale lies around Mt. Yaojun and was once under an unnamed mistress who presided over wild spirits and animals; during the Archon War she fought Morax, and the adepti Fujin, Lingyuan and the Herblord sided against her flood plan. Many present-day inhabitants descend from refugees who fled the Chasm at the time of the cataclysm. In the present the suanni adeptus Lingyuan tampers with the vale's spirit lines, tainting the soil and water and the village's tea, until the Traveler helps Fujin restore balance.

Placement: Follows 4.3 and precedes 4.5. Chenyu Vale's history draws on events set far before the game's present (the Archon War), while the present-day quest chain happens in Liyue.

key: Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze
145.comment: Version 4.4: Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze: Chenyu Vale (version context)
145.content: Version 4.4 (2024-01-31): Chenyu Vale opens in Liyue, with Xianyun and Gaming as new characters and no Archon Quest.

146.content:
Version 4.5: Blades Weaving Betwixt Brocade (also: Version 4.5, Genshin Impact 4.5, 4.5 update): Version 4.5, "Blades Weaving Betwixt Brocade", was released on 2024-03-13. It added Chiori (5-star Geo Sword), the owner of Chioriya Boutique in Fontaine. It has no new region and no Archon Quest.

The version is built around Chiori's own Story Quest and a Mondstadt-based alchemy event. Its official tagline pairs a booming potion trade in Mondstadt with Chiori's unorthodox work in fashion.

New content: New weapons: Uraku Misugiri (5-star Sword) and Dialogues of the Desert Sages (4-star Polearm, an event reward). A new book, Perinheri, was added.

Banners ran as Of Silken Clouds Woven (Chiori), Oni's Royale (Arataki Itto), Ode to the Dawn Breeze (a Chronicled Wish for Mondstadt characters and weapons), Decree of the Deeps (Neuvillette) and Leaves in the Wind (Kaedehara Kazuha).

Story content: Chiori's Story Quest is about the owner of Chioriya Boutique, called "The Thundering Seamstress".

The quest is listed as requiring the Fontaine Archon Quest Act V first. The official blurb describes her as hard to read, a designer whose blades slice fabric as if only one choice existed.

Event: Alchemical Ascension was a flagship event running from 2024-03-14 to 2024-04-01.

Set in Mondstadt, it has Lisa invite the Traveler and Paimon to help the Knights of Favonius promote alchemy. Players cultivate ingredients, concoct potions and sell them to grow a shop. Its recommended prerequisites were Archon Quest Chapter IV Act V and Eula's Story Quest Aphros Delos Chapter Act I.

Placement: Follows 4.4 and precedes 4.6.

This version has no Archon Quest. Its events are limited-time, so characters should know of them only if they took part.

key: Version 4.6: Two Worlds Aflame, the Crimson Night Fades
147.comment: Version 4.6: Two Worlds Aflame, the Crimson Night Fades
147.content:
Version 4.6: Two Worlds Aflame, the Crimson Night Fades (also: Version 4.6, Genshin Impact 4.6, 4.6 update): Version 4.6, "Two Worlds Aflame, the Crimson Night Fades", was released on 2024-04-24. It added Arlecchino (5-star Pyro Polearm) and two new areas in Fontaine: the Sea of Bygone Eras and the Nostoi Region. It has no Archon Quest.

The exploration content is the ancient civilisation Remuria, which preceded Egeria's rule. The Faded Castle, once home to the Harmosts and scholars of Remuria, leads down to the deeper ruins. Arlecchino's own Story Quest arrives with the version.

New content: New weapon: Crimson Moon's Semblance (5-star Polearm). New artifact sets: Unfinished Reverie and Fragment of Harmonic Whimsy.

Banners ran as The Hearth's Ashen Shadow (Arlecchino), Conjuring Chiaroscuro (Lyney), From Ashes Reborn (Wanderer) and Immaculate Pulse (Baizhu). Arlecchino's Story Quest is Ignis Purgatorius Chapter Act I - When the Hearth-Flame Goes Out. The Lupus Aureus Chapter Act II - Oathkeeper, a Story Quest for Cyno, also released.

Areas: The Nostoi Region sits off the main Fontaine plate, so its waters cannot be dived into. The Sea of Bygone Eras is a separate map reached from the Faded Castle.

The Sea of Bygone Eras has its own map tab and exploration progress and unlocks after completing the Underwater Nocturne quest. Its in-game text calls it the undersea capital and lost homeland and says its long-forgotten symphony sounds once more. Petrichor and the Faded Castle are within the Nostoi Region, and the Faded Castle is first reached during The Shadow Over Petrichor.

Story content: Arlecchino's quest follows an "aftershadow" in the House of the Hearth.

The official quest blurb describes a shadow that should not exist wandering the House of the Hearth's halls, bringing goodwill and hastening ill deeds. It requires the Archon Quest Act V as a prerequisite. Cyno's Act II is set in Sumeru City and concerns a case tied to a mysterious organization.

Placement: Follows 4.5 and precedes 4.7.

Characters who have not explored Nostoi or the Sea of Bygone Eras may know Remuria only from rumours and books.

148.content:
Version 4.7: An Everlasting Dream Intertwined (also: Version 4.7, Genshin Impact 4.7, 4.7 update): Version 4.7, "An Everlasting Dream Intertwined", was released on 2024-06-05. It added Clorinde (5-star Electro Sword), Sigewinne (5-star Hydro Bow) and Sethos (4-star Electro Bow), and the Imaginarium Theater. It finished Archon Quest Chapter IV with Act VI, Bedtime Story.

Act VI is an epilogue set in Sumeru, not Fontaine. The Traveler takes a commission to find a villager whom nobody remembers well, and meets Dainsleif and then Caribert. The Traveler's sibling appears in a memory.

New content: New weapons: Absolution (5-star Sword), Silvershower Heartstrings (5-star Bow) and Cloudforged (4-star Bow). No new region was added.

Banners ran as Illuminating Lightning (Clorinde and Sethos), Caution in Confidence (Alhaitham and Sethos), Romaritime Meluserenity (Sigewinne) and Chanson of Many Waters (Furina). Clorinde's Story Quest is Rapperia Chapter Act I - Silent Night, and Sigewinne's is Nereides Chapter Act I - The Warmth of Lies.

Story: Archon Quest Chapter IV, Act VI: Bedtime Story. It follows three quests: Cold Case Commission, Memories That Should Not Exist and World-Order Narration.

A joint commission from the people of Vimara Village asks for a missing man whom none of them can name. Atossa remembers sitting with him at dusk beneath a tree, when the sun never seemed to move. Dainsleif is also investigating the Abyss Order and tells the Traveler that the mysterious voice from their last meeting belongs to his elder brother, Vedrfolnir, one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah.

Characters introduced: Clorinde is Fontaine's strongest Champion Duelist and has been in the story since 4.0. Sigewinne is the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse. Sethos is new in this version. Caribert appears only in Bedtime Story.

Placement: Follows 4.6 and precedes 4.8.

Bedtime Story takes place after Masquerade of the Guilty and is the first Chapter IV act set outside Fontaine. Details of the sibling's goals and the Loom of Fate should not be known to the Traveler's companions who were not present.

149.content:
Version 4.8: Summertide Scales and Tales (also: Version 4.8, Genshin Impact 4.8, 4.8 update): Version 4.8, "Summertide Scales and Tales", was released on 2024-07-17. It added Emilie (5-star Dendro Polearm) and the limited-time summer event in Simulanka. It has no Archon Quest and is the last version before Natlan in 5.0.

The version has no main-story chapter; its story content is the limited-time event and Emilie's Story Quest.

New content: New weapon: Lumidouce Elegy (5-star Polearm). Emilie's Story Quest is Pomum de Ambra Chapter Act I - Floral Debt, Blood Due.

Banners ran as In the Name of the Rosula (Navia), Twirling Lotus (Nilou), Ambrosial Essence (Emilie) and Discerner of Enigmas (Yelan). The official blurb for Emilie's quest says the legendary flower Auguste, once popular in Fontaine, was lost in a fire and rumours of it returning in Sumeru draw people to Port Ormos.

Event: Summertide Scales and Tales was a flagship event running from 2024-07-17 to 2024-08-28, set in the limited-time area Simulanka.

Simulanka is a world created by Alice, Barbeloth and Andersdotter of the Hexenzirkel, whom its people call the Goddesses of Creation, Prophecy and Fate. Alice brought the Traveler, Paimon, Nilou, Kirara, Navia and the Wanderer there to experience its story. Visions do not work in Simulanka.

Placement: Follows 4.7 and precedes 5.0.

Version 4.8 closes the 4.x series. Characters should know the event only if they took part.

key: Version 5.0: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn
150.comment: Version 5.0: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn
150.content:
Version 5.0: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn (also: Version 5.0, Genshin Impact 5.0, Natlan release): Version 5.0, "Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn", was released on 2024-08-28. It opened Natlan, the Pyro nation, as a new nation, and began Chapter V of the Archon Quest. New characters were Mualani, Kinich and Kachina.

It follows Version 4.8 and precedes 5.1. The version added four Natlan subregions (the Basin of Unnumbered Flames, Coatepec Mountain, Tequemecan Valley and Toyac Springs) and the Chapter V Archon Quest Acts I and II.

Release: Released 2024-08-28, between 4.8 and 5.1.

Phase I banners were Sharktacular Surfari (Mualani and Kachina) and Leaves in the Wind (Kaedehara Kazuha and Kachina). Phase II brought Seeker of Flame-Wrought Secrets (Kinich) and Reign of Serenity (the Raiden Shogun).

Characters: Mualani ("Splish-Splash Wavechaser") is a five-star Hydro Catalyst character. Kinich ("Turnfire Hunt") is a five-star Dendro Claymore character. Kachina ("Mottled Gold Yet Unsmelted") is a four-star Geo Polearm character. Their own files carry the profiles.

Archon quest: Chapter V Act I, also titled Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn, has the quests Natlan! A New Adventure, Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame and Home of the Hot Springs. Act II, Black Stone Under a White Stone, has A Decision, To Reclaim an Ancient Name, Echoes of Life, Into Eternal Night and Past and Future. Both need Adventure Rank 40, and Act I could be started at rank 28 through a quick start after A New Star Approaches.

New region: Natlan's four launch subregions were the Basin of Unnumbered Flames, Coatepec Mountain, Tequemecan Valley and Toyac Springs. Story quests in the Tribal Chronicles series introduced three of the tribes: the People of the Springs, the Scions of the Canopy and the Children of Echoes.

151.comment: Version 5.0: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn: Tribal Chronicles
151.content: The Story Quest series that gives each Natlan tribe its own chapter. Version 5.0 opened three: People of the Springs (Where the Springs Return, Acts I to III), Scions of the Canopy (Yupanqui's Turnfire, Acts I to III) and Children of Echoes (A Prayer for Blessings, Told to Crested Peaks, Acts I and II).

key: Version 5.1: The Rainbow Destined to Burn
152.comment: Version 5.1: The Rainbow Destined to Burn
152.content:
Version 5.1: The Rainbow Destined to Burn (also: Version 5.1, Genshin Impact 5.1): Version 5.1, "The Rainbow Destined to Burn", was released on 2024-10-09. It added no new region. Its main content was Chapter V Acts III and IV of the Archon Quest and one new character, the five-star Geo Sword user Xilonen.

It follows Version 5.0 and precedes 5.2. The two acts turn the story from a Pilgrimage tournament into an open war: the Fatui Harbinger Capitano pursues a plan of his own and the Abyss launches a nationwide invasion.

Release: Released 2024-10-09, between 5.0 and 5.2.

Phase I banners were Forgefire's Blessing (Xilonen) and Of Silken Clouds Woven (Chiori). Phase II banners were The Moongrass' Enlightenment (Nahida) and Moment of Bloom (Hu Tao).

Characters: Xilonen ("Ardent Flames Forge the Soul") is a five-star Geo Sword character. Her own file carries her profile.

Archon quest: Act III, Beyond the Smoke and Mirrors, has the quests All Names are Noble, To Whence the Smoke Drifts and The Flickering Light Splits in Twain. Act IV, The Rainbow Destined to Burn, has Beneath the Secret Source, As One We Watch the Setting Sun, The Surging Darkness, Despair Engulfs the Heavens, No One Fights Alone and A Fuel Named "Fate". Both need Adventure Rank 40.

153.comment: Version 5.1: The Rainbow Destined to Burn: Source Mechanism
153.content: A device from the Secret Source that Capitano and Ororon located with the help of three scholars, hoping to use it to rebuild Natlan's Ley Lines. When it was activated it woke Yohualtecuhtin, the Lord of the Night, who explained it was the source of the nation's Ley Lines.

key: Version 5.2: Tapestry of Spirit and Flame
154.comment: Version 5.2: Tapestry of Spirit and Flame
154.content:
Version 5.2: Tapestry of Spirit and Flame (also: Version 5.2, Genshin Impact 5.2): Version 5.2, "Tapestry of Spirit and Flame", was released on 2024-11-20. It added three Natlan areas, the Interlude Archon Quest of Chapter V, All Fires Fuel the Flame, and two characters: Chasca, a five-star Anemo Bow user, and Ororon, a four-star Electro Bow user. It was also the first version to support Xbox Series X and S and Xbox Game Pass.

It follows Version 5.1 and precedes 5.3. The new areas are Tezcatepetonco Range, Quahuacan Cliff and Ochkanatlan. The Interlude is a one-quest story set after the invasion of 5.1, in which the Traveler helps a tribe recover from the war.

Release: Released 2024-11-20, between 5.1 and 5.3.

Phase I banners were Piercing Shot's Crimson Wake (Chasca and Ororon) and Conjuring Chiaroscuro (Lyney and Ororon). Phase II banners were Decree of the Deeps (Neuvillette) and Gentry of Hermitage (Zhongli).

Characters: Chasca ("Skyborne Arbiter") is a five-star Anemo Bow character. Ororon ("Shadow of the Night-Wind") is a four-star Electro Bow character. Their own files carry the profiles.

Archon quest: Chapter V: Interlude, All Fires Fuel the Flame, has one quest, For the Same Land. It needs Adventure Rank 40.

New areas: The new areas are Tezcatepetonco Range, Quahuacan Cliff and Ochkanatlan. World quest chains include Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm, Every Aspect of a Warrior and additions to In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons.

155.comment: Version 5.2: Tapestry of Spirit and Flame: Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome
155.content: An illness that follows fighting the Abyss and can leave a warrior in hallucinations. Capitano says some cases ease through talk or contact, while severe ones need the Draught of Lucidity, which leaves the patient with lasting migraines.

156.content:
Version 5.3: Incandescent Ode of Resurrection (also: Version 5.3, Genshin Impact 5.3): Version 5.3, "Incandescent Ode of Resurrection", was released on 2025-01-01. It added no new region. Its main content was Chapter V Act V, which ends the Natlan war, and three new characters: Mavuika (five-star Pyro Claymore), Citlali (five-star Cryo Catalyst) and Lan Yan (four-star Anemo Catalyst). It also gave the Traveler a Pyro form.

It follows Version 5.2 and precedes 5.4. In Act V the Traveler receives an Ancient Name, goes with Mavuika into the Night Kingdom to end the Abyss threat, and then helps decide what Natlan's victory will cost.

Release: Released 2025-01-01, between 5.2 and 5.4.

Phase I banners were Ancient Flame Ablaze (Mavuika) and Starry Night's Whispers (Citlali). Phase II banners were The Hearth's Ashen Shadow (Arlecchino and Lan Yan) and Illuminating Lightning (Clorinde and Lan Yan), and a Chronicled Wish named Remembrance of Jade and Stone.

Events: Limited-time events of the version included Springtime Charms with its Lantern-Lit Gathering, May Fortune Find You: Spring's Premonition, Emblem of Steadfast Valor and On the Trail of Behemoths. They ran only during the version and are not universal knowledge.

Characters: Mavuika ("Night-Igniting Flame") is a five-star Pyro Claymore character and the Pyro Archon. Citlali ("Obsidian Opalstar") is a five-star Cryo Catalyst character. Lan Yan ("Spring Woven From Jade") is a four-star Anemo Catalyst character. Their own files carry the profiles.

Archon quest: Chapter V Act V has five quests: Subterranean Ruins, As the Sun Rises and Sets, Journey of Stars and Flames, Where All Hopes Lie and When All Becomes a Monument. It needs Adventure Rank 40.

157.comment: Version 5.3: Incandescent Ode of Resurrection: Pilgrim's Chronicle
157.content: A parchment made by the Lord of the Night that records the Traveler's deeds in Natlan, past and future, so that Xilonen can forge a Name for an outsider. It first recorded their help in Kachina's victory in the Pilgrimage.

158.content:
Version 5.4: Moonlight Amidst Dreams (also: Version 5.4, Update 5.4, Patch 5.4, Moonlight Amidst Dreams): Version 5.4, "Moonlight Amidst Dreams", was released on 2025-02-12. It added Yumemizuki Mizuki, a dream-eating baku who treats patients at the Aisa Bathhouse in Inazuma City, and her Story Quest "Dream Eater's Melancholia". It had no Archon Quest.

Mizuki's quest is the first act of the Tapirus Somniator Chapter and needs Chapter II Act III, "Transient Dreams" and Adventure Rank 40. The bathhouse is a Natlan-inspired spa that offers psychotherapy by baku staff.

Contents: Character: Yumemizuki Mizuki (5-star Anemo catalyst). Weapons: Sunny Morning Sleep-In (5-star catalyst) and Tamayuratei no Ohanashi (4-star polearm). New location: Aisa Bathhouse (instance).

Story: On a night walk the Traveler and Paimon stumble into Mizuki's dream-eating. She is a baku, a youkai that feeds on dreams and nightmares, and works as a clinical psychologist and major investor at Aisa Bathhouse. The bathhouse is struggling financially while a rival psychotherapy clinic promises better results, and the Traveler investigates.

Placement: Follows 5.3 and precedes 5.5. The Aisa Bathhouse page says the bathhouse was renovated after the Natlan quest "Incandescent Ode of Resurrection", under Mizuki's direction.

159.comment: Version 5.4: Moonlight Amidst Dreams: Version 5.4 Aisa Bathhouse
159.content: Aisa Bathhouse is an indoor bathhouse in Inazuma City, inspired by the hot springs of Natlan. It offers a spa, fine dining and psychotherapy from resident baku, including Mizuki. Its owner is Aikawa Susumu, who returned from Natlan, and its baku staff are Hyakujitsuhaku Shion and Shiba Murasaki. Many Tenryou Commission samurai visit.

160.comment: Version 5.4: Moonlight Amidst Dreams: Version 5.4 Dream Eater's Melancholia
160.content: Dream Eater's Melancholia has five quests: "Encounter in the Realm of Dreams", "Crisis at the Aisa Bathhouse", "A Deceit Called Happiness", "Descendant of Nightmares" and "Afterword". Mizuki explains that she cries during the last stage of digesting nightmares. She identifies nightmare monsters as the natural enemy of baku, and Kuroyume says he is the last of his kind.

161.comment: Version 5.4: Moonlight Amidst Dreams: Version 5.4 New Character
161.content: Version 5.4 introduced Yumemizuki Mizuki ("Embrace of Enchanting Dreams"), a 5-star Anemo catalyst user and baku youkai. Her banner "Dawn's Drifting Reverie" was limited-time and may be rerun.

key: Version 5.5: Day of the Flame's Return
162.comment: Version 5.5: Day of the Flame's Return
162.content:
Version 5.5: Day of the Flame's Return (also: Version 5.5, Genshin Impact 5.5): Version 5.5, "Day of the Flame's Return", was released on 2025-03-26. It had no Archon Quest. It added two Natlan areas, Atocpan and the Ancient Sacred Mountain, and two characters: Varesa (five-star Electro Catalyst) and Iansan (four-star Electro Polearm).

It follows Version 5.4 and precedes 5.6. The version's main story was a Tribal Chronicles chapter for the Collective of Plenty, and its main event, Tournament of Glory in Bloom, staged war games between the six tribes.

Release: Released 2025-03-26, between 5.4 and 5.6.

Phase I banners were Cornucopia of Contention (Varesa and Iansan) and The Crane Soars Skyward (Xianyun and Iansan). Phase II banners were Forgefire's Blessing (Xilonen) and Ballad in Goblets (Venti).

Characters: Varesa ("Strength in Serenity") is a five-star Electro Catalyst character. Iansan ("Tempered in Molten Stone") is a four-star Electro Polearm character. Their own files carry the profiles.

Story: The Tribal Chronicles chapter for the Collective of Plenty is Mushroom Realm Mystery. In its first act the Traveler and Paimon meet Varesa near the Great Volcano of Tollan and she guides them to her tribe. In the second she shows them the tribe's camp and her family's orchard.

Events: Limited-time events of the version included Tournament of Glory in Bloom, Quirky Quaking Arena, Rhythm Ball Meztli, Unlimited Fighting Championship, Overflowing Favor, The Sacred Mountain and Sanctified Land and a Mushroom Realm Mystery event. They ran only during the version and are not universal knowledge.

163.comment: Version 5.5: Day of the Flame's Return: Ancient Sacred Mountain
163.content: An area inside the Great Volcano of Tollan, containing the Sacred City of Tollan, the capital of the dragon civilisation that once ruled Natlan. It opens through the quest Nahuatzin's Leap, and its lower levels open as the quests progress.

164.content:
Version 5.6: Paralogism (also: Version 5.6, Genshin Impact 5.6): Version 5.6, "Paralogism", was released on 2025-05-07. It added no new area. Its main content was the Archon Quest Interlude Chapter Act IV, also titled Paralogism, and two new characters: Escoffier, a five-star Cryo Polearm user, and Ifa, a four-star Anemo Catalyst user.

It follows Version 5.5 and precedes 5.7. The Archon Quest takes place in Mondstadt during the Windblume Festival and deals with a murder trial against Albedo, which turns out to be a trap for a monster that imitates other people.

Release: Released 2025-05-07, between 5.5 and 5.7.

Phase I banners were La Chanson Cerise (Escoffier and Ifa) and In the Name of the Rosula (Navia and Ifa). Phase II, from 2025-05-27, reran Kinich, the Raiden Shogun and a Chronicled Wish.

Characters: Escoffier ("Tasteful Excellence") is a five-star Cryo Polearm character; the wiki describes her as a renowned Fontainian chef, formerly of Hotel Debord, with exacting standards. Ifa ("In the Wake of Wandering Winds") is a four-star Anemo Catalyst character. Their own files cover their profiles.

Archon quest: Paralogism (Interlude Chapter Act IV) needs Adventure Rank 40 and the earlier acts Inversion of Genesis and Traveler Observation Report. During 5.6 up to before 6.0 a Quick Start let players enter it at Adventure Rank 28 after A New Star Approaches. It has three quests: Crimes One and Two, The Hunger of Many and The Gardener.

165.content: Paralogism is the fourth act of the Interlude Chapter, set at Mondstadt's Windblume Festival. It centres on Albedo's trial, a trap for a shapeshifting spawn of Durin, and ends with Mini Durin becoming human. Characters include Albedo, Venti, Jean, Eula, Kaeya, Diluc, Rosaria, the Hexenzirkel's Alice and Barbeloth.

key: Version 5.7: A Space and Time for You
166.comment: Version 5.7: A Space and Time for You
166.content:
Version 5.7: A Space and Time for You (also: Version 5.7, Genshin Impact 5.7): Version 5.7, "A Space and Time for You", was released on 2025-06-18. It added no new area. Its main content was Chapter V Act VI of the Archon Quest, set in Natlan, and two characters: Skirk (five-star Cryo Sword) and Dahlia (four-star Hydro Sword).

It follows Version 5.6 and precedes 5.8. Act VI returns to the thread of the Traveler's search for their sibling, who is revealed to lead the Abyss Order's activities in Natlan.

Release: Released 2025-06-18, between 5.6 and 5.8.

Phase I banners were Void Star's Advent (Skirk and Dahlia) and The Transcendent One Returns (Shenhe and Dahlia). Phase II banners were Ancient Flame Ablaze (Mavuika) and Ambrosial Essence (Emilie).

Characters: Skirk ("Void Star") is a five-star Cryo Sword character. Dahlia ("Ode and Oblation") is a four-star Hydro Sword character. Their own files carry the profiles.

Archon quest: Chapter V Act VI, A Space and Time for You, has three quests: The Key That Unlocks Fate, "Savior" and A Space and Time Without You. It needs Adventure Rank 40.

167.comment: Version 5.7: A Space and Time for You: Direidyth
167.content: A woman from a faraway village, sent by her grandmother to find a Savior who could stop a prophesied doomsday. The Traveler can see the monsters stalking her only while holding her hand. She and the Traveler later learn they are from different points in time.

168.comment: Version 5.7: A Space and Time for You: Iniquitous Baptist
168.content: An Abyss Order leader met at the Order's stronghold in Ochkanatlan, after the Order attacked every Natlan tribe at once, which Iansan calls its first coordinated attack there. Dainsleif identifies him as Haden, his former master.

169.content:
Version 5.8: Sunspray Summer Resort (also: Version 5.8, Genshin Impact 5.8): Version 5.8, "Sunspray Summer Resort", was released on 2025-07-30. It added the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, a summer-themed area, the prelude act of the Song of the Welkin Moon Archon Quest, The Journey Home, the Lunar-Charged elemental reaction and one new character, the five-star Electro Polearm user Ineffa.

It follows Version 5.7 and was the last version before 6.0, which moves the story to Nod-Krai. The Journey Home is set in Natlan, bridges Chapter V and the next chapter, and brings in visitors from Nod-Krai.

Release: Released 2025-07-30, between 5.7 and 6.0.

Phase I banners were Astral Actuation (Ineffa) and a rerun of Starry Night's Whispers (Citlali). Phase II banners were Sharktacular Surfari (Mualani) and Piercing Shot's Crimson Wake (Chasca).

Characters: Ineffa ("Boom Boom Thunderwave") is a five-star Electro Polearm character. Her own file carries the profile.

Lunar charged: Lunar-Charged is a new elemental reaction added in 5.8 and is labelled as game mechanics: when Electro meets Hydro and certain other conditions are met, a thundercloud forms and repeatedly strikes nearby targets affected by both elements for Electro damage.

Archon quest: The Journey Home is the prelude act of Song of the Welkin Moon and has three quests: Flamelets, Smoldering and Searing. It needs Adventure Rank 40, with a Quick Start from Adventure Rank 28 after A New Star Approaches, and is followed by A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves in 6.0.

170.comment: Version 5.8: Sunspray Summer Resort: Easybreeze Holiday Resort
170.content: A sparsely inhabited island off the westernmost edge of Natlan, which the wiki says is where the long war had begun and met its end. Its name Tenochtzitoc translates as a cavern of stone and prickly pears, though prickly pears no longer grow there. It is the setting of the Sunspray Summer Resort Story Quest.

171.comment: Version 5.8: Sunspray Summer Resort: Leaping Spirit Piano
171.content: A new instrument for the Repertoire of Myriad Melodies added in 5.8, purchasable from Djembe Studios.

key: Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
Song of the Welkin Moon: Segue
172.comment: Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
172.content:
Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves (also: Version 6.0, Genshin Impact 6.0, Version Luna I, Luna I, Song of the Welkin Moon: Segue): Version 6.0, officially "Luna I" (Song of the Welkin Moon: Segue), was released on 2025-09-10. It opened the new region Nod-Krai and added Archon Quest Acts I-II, with the new characters Lauma, Flins and Aino.

It follows Version 5.8 and precedes Luna II (6.1). The wiki notes it is the first version not officially referred to by its number, being the first update of the "Luna" cycle.

Release: Released 2025-09-10, after 5.8 and before Luna II (6.1).

Phase I banners: Moonsong of the Groves (Lauma), The Moongrass' Enlightenment (Nahida), Roving Chalice of Dewgrass (Chronicled Wish). Phase II, from 2025-09-30: The Lone Light Knocks at Night (Flins and Aino) and Discerner of Enigmas (Yelan and Aino).

Region: New region: Nod-Krai, with Lempo Isle, Hiisi Island and Paha Isle. In the story it is a northern archipelago rich in kuuvahki, the pure energy of the moon, where Fatui forces have recently arrived.

Characters: Lauma ("Evermoon's Sacrament Song") is a 5-star Dendro Catalyst, Flins ("Shadowy Lights, Stranger Wights") a 5-star Electro Polearm, Aino ("Clinky-Clank Gadgets-A-Gogo") a 4-star Hydro Claymore.

Archon quest: Song of the Welkin Moon Act I, "A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves", and Act II, "Elegy of Dust and Lamplight".

key: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
173.comment: Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
173.content: Act I of Song of the Welkin Moon and the title of Version 6.0. The Traveler, Paimon and Ineffa leave Natlan by boat for Nasha Town in Nod-Krai. The Traveler recognises the moon-power as the same they felt after landing on Teyvat and searches for their spaceship. They meet the Ratnik Flins, the Moonchanter Lauma, the inventor Aino, the Curatorium's Nefer and her employee Jahoda, are warned by the Harbinger Marionette, and meet Columbina. The act ends with the Moon Marrow stored inside the Traveler and Lauma telling her people that the sky is false.

174.comment: Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves: Elegy of Dust and Lamplight
174.content: Act II of Song of the Welkin Moon. The Wild Hunt grows bolder, and Rerir, who is behind it, manipulates Aino's cannon to restore part of his body. The Traveler and Flins, who is accused of killing Sousi, stop the shot only in part; Columbina saves the group from Rerir.

175.comment: Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves: Moon Marrow
175.content: The Frostmoon Scions' relic in Version 6.0 is the Moon Marrow, used in a ritual held when the moon is closest to Teyvat. Columbina says this one is a piece of the remains of a moon goddess, Aria. It was stolen from the sanctum, held by Marionette, and recovered by the Traveler.

key: Version 6.1: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight
Song of the Welkin Moon: Reprise
176.comment: Version 6.1: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight
176.content:
Version 6.1: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight (also: Version 6.1, Genshin Impact 6.1, Version Luna II, Luna II, Song of the Welkin Moon: Reprise): Version 6.1, officially "Luna II" (Song of the Welkin Moon: Reprise), was released on 2025-10-22 as "An Elegy for Faded Moonlight". It added no new area. Its main content was Archon Quest Acts III and IV, the 5-star Dendro Catalyst Nefer and the open beta of Miliastra Wonderland.

It follows Version 6.0 (Luna I) and precedes Luna III (6.2). In the Archon Quest, the Traveler and the people of Nod-Krai finish the fight against the Wild Hunt's mastermind, Rerir.

Release: Released 2025-10-22, after Luna I (6.0) and before Luna III (6.2).

Phase I banners: Temptation of the Crimson Sands (Nefer) and Chanson of Many Waters (Furina). Phase II: The Hearth's Ashen Shadow (Arlecchino) and Gentry of Hermitage (Zhongli).

Characters: Nefer ("Secret Beneath the Sands") is a 5-star Dendro Catalyst. The Wonderland Manekin is a 5-star Sword character for Miliastra Wonderland.

Miliastra wonderland: Miliastra Wonderland entered open beta in this version, with creator-made stages, social features and customisation content.

Archon quest: Song of the Welkin Moon Act III, "A Nation That Doesn't Exist", and Act IV, "An Elegy for Faded Moonlight". Both need Adventure Rank 40.

177.comment: Version 6.1: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight: A Nation That Doesn't Exist
177.content: Act III of Song of the Welkin Moon. The Wild Hunt drains the kuuvahki from places such as the quarry, and Rerir attacks Columbina. Varka rescues the group and brings the Curatorium's Nefer into the plan. Columbina goes with the Traveler to the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau, where Sandrone agrees to help, then to Arlecchino, who agrees to find the Iridescent Marrow.

key: Dance of Death: Serpent and Scorpion
178.comment: Version 6.1: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight
178.content: Act IV of Song of the Welkin Moon and the title of Version 6.1. Dainsleif explains how the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah came to be; Nefer's ritual shows Rerir's past and then pulls the group into her own memories. Rerir is sealed in Nefer's chessbox, breaks out, and is thrown out of Teyvat through a moon gate.

key: Version 6.2: A Nocturne of the Far North
Song of the Welkin Moon: Interlude
179.comment: Version 6.2: A Nocturne of the Far North
179.content:
Version 6.2: A Nocturne of the Far North (also: Version 6.2, Genshin Impact 6.2, Version Luna III, Luna III, Song of the Welkin Moon: Interlude): Version 6.2, officially "Luna III" (Song of the Welkin Moon: Interlude), was released on 2025-12-03 as "A Nocturne of the Far North". It added no new area. Its main content was Archon Quest Acts V and VI, the Story Quest Draco Rubedo Chapter, and the characters Durin (5-star Pyro Sword) and Jahoda (4-star Anemo Bow).

It follows Luna II (6.1) and precedes Luna IV (6.3). The Archon Quest centres on Moon-Prayer Night, the festival on which the fading Moon Goddess Columbina planned to return to the moon.

Release: Released 2025-12-03, after Luna II (6.1) and before Luna IV (6.3).

Phase I banners: Rubedo, of White Stone Born (Durin and Jahoda) and Ballad in Goblets (Venti and Jahoda). Phase II: Cornucopia of Contention (Varesa) and Forgefire's Blessing (Xilonen).

Characters: Durin ("The Undying Fire") is a 5-star Pyro Sword character; Jahoda ("Windthreading Shadow") is a 4-star Anemo Bow character.

Archon quest: Song of the Welkin Moon Act V, "A Nocturne of the Far North", and Act VI, "Melting Moonlight in the Morning Mist". Both need Adventure Rank 40.

key: A Nocturne of the Far North
In the Shifting Light of the Moon
180.comment: Version 6.2: A Nocturne of the Far North: A Nocturne of the Far North
180.content: Act V of Song of the Welkin Moon and the title of Version 6.2. About two months after the Traveler's arrival, Nod-Krai prepares for Moon-Prayer Night. Columbina tells the Traveler she will return to the moon on that night; if she stays in Teyvat she will cease to exist. Phantoms and mirages of Nod-Krai's past appear. Columbina then disappears from Silvermoon Hall and fades, and Alice appears to tell the Traveler the border of Teyvat is destabilising and to name two tasks: find Columbina's true name and send her to the real moon.

key: Melting Moonlight in the Morning Mist
The Night the Moon Returns Home
181.comment: Version 6.2: A Nocturne of the Far North: Melting Moonlight in the Morning Mist
181.content: Act VI of Song of the Welkin Moon. In the Hyperborean ruins the group learns the history of the Three Moons and that Columbina has no true name from the past; she is restored by being called Columbina. After a night of festival, Dottore ambushes her at the ritual, and she vanishes into a moon gate. The story ends with the allies pledging to find her.

key: Version 6.3: A Traveler on a Winter's Night
Song of the Welkin Moon: Postlude
182.comment: Version 6.3: A Traveler on a Winter's Night
182.content:
Version 6.3: A Traveler on a Winter's Night (also: Version 6.3, Genshin Impact 6.3, Version Luna IV, Luna IV, Song of the Welkin Moon: Postlude): Version 6.3, officially "Luna IV" (Song of the Welkin Moon: Postlude), was released on 2026-01-14 as "A Traveler on a Winter's Night". It added the Nod-Krai area The Lament of the Cliff-Shadowed Hollow, Archon Quest Acts VII and VIII, and the characters Columbina, Zibai and Illuga.

It follows Luna III (6.2) and precedes Luna V (6.4). The Archon Quest follows the fight against the Fatui Harbinger Dottore, who has trapped Columbina and then the Traveler, and ends with the Moon Goddess's return.

Release: Released 2026-01-14, after Luna III (6.2) and before Luna V (6.4).

Phase I banners: Somnias a Luna (Columbina) and Astral Actuation (Ineffa). Phase II, from 2026-02-03: Harmonious Abundance (Zibai and Illuga) and Decree of the Deeps (Neuvillette and Illuga).

Region: New area: Nod-Krai: The Lament of the Cliff-Shadowed Hollow, with Voidsea Outlook, Wavechaser Plain and Ashveil Peak.

Characters: Columbina ("Welkin Moon's Homecoming") is a 5-star Hydro Catalyst, Zibai ("White Horse's Fleeting Spring") a 5-star Geo Sword, and Illuga ("Nightmare's Burning Heart") a 4-star Geo Polearm.

Archon quest: Song of the Welkin Moon Act VII, "A Traveler on a Winter's Night", and Act VIII, "True Moon". Both need Adventure Rank 40.

key: A Traveler on a Winter's Night
Where Our Space and Time Intersect
Tracing the Footsteps of the Past
183.comment: Version 6.3: A Traveler on a Winter's Night: A Traveler on a Winter's Night
183.content: Act VII of Song of the Welkin Moon and the title of Version 6.3. A few days after the Dottore incident, the Traveler and friends go to Dottore's lab, where Sandrone and Arlecchino had gone first. Dottore, armed with an artificial Moon Marrow that heals his wounds, captures the Traveler and sends the rest away. Dottore's false moon replaces the Frost Moon, energy fields appear across the islands, and everyone who entered his lab is cursed. Columbina, alive in the moon's reflection, leaves messages in the past.

184.comment: Version 6.3: A Traveler on a Winter's Night: True Moon
184.content: Act VIII of Song of the Welkin Moon. The Wanderer rescues the Traveler. Columbina meets the Moon Sisters in their prison and, with their help, returns. In the final battle against Dottore she and the Traveler overcome his Heretic of the False Moon form, but Sandrone dies saving the Traveler. Afterwards Columbina lives with the Frostmoon Scions, shows the Traveler their spaceship on the Frost Moon, and gives the Traveler a gift that loosens some of Teyvat's limits on the elements.

key: Version 6.4: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind
Song of the Welkin Moon: Variation
Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind update
185.comment: Version 6.4: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind
185.content:
Version 6.4: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind (also: Version 6.4, Patch 6.4, Version Luna V, Luna V, Song of the Welkin Moon: Variation, Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind update): Version Luna V (numbered 6.4 on the wiki, with the Archon Quest subtitle "Song of the Welkin Moon: Variation") was released on 2026-02-25, after Luna IV. It added Varka, Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, his first Story Quest and a Mondstadt homecoming event. It opened no new area.

The Story Quest, Lupus Majoris Chapter Act I, follows Varka's last expedition in Nod-Krai against a corrupted fragment of the wolf god Andrius, while Mondstadt waits for the Knights to come home.

Release: Released 2026-02-25. Previous: Luna IV. Next: Luna VI.

New character: Varka ("Knight of Boreas", 5-star Anemo claymore). New weapon: Gest of the Mighty Wolf (5-star claymore). New weapon appearances: Unbreakable: Durandarte and Phantasmal Gift: Star Omen.

New content: Varka. Lupus Majoris Chapter Act I, "To Those Who Embark on the Expedition". Event: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind.

The Story Quest needs Adventure Rank 40 and "True Moon", the final Act of Song of the Welkin Moon, though players who have not reached it can use a quick start from "A New Star Approaches".

key: Homeward He Who Caught the Wind
186.comment: Version 6.4: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind: Version 6.4 Homeward event
186.content: This flagship event ran from 2026-02-27 to 2026-03-16. It needed Adventure Rank 20 and Prologue Act III, "Song of the Dragon and Freedom", and players are advised to finish "True Moon" and Lupus Majoris Chapter Act I first. The Traveler and Paimon are invited to Mondstadt for a welcome ceremony from the Knights of Favonius.

key: To Those Who Embark on the Expedition
187.comment: Version 6.4: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind: Version 6.4 Lupus Majoris Chapter
187.content: "To Those Who Embark on the Expedition" has three quests: Triumphant Warrior, Fated Warrior and Lonely Warrior. It begins with Venti, who learns that Varka's expedition has ended and that Lohen, Vice Captain of the 5th Company, is delivering Varka's letters to friends of the Knights.

key: Song of the Welkin Moon: Rondo
188.content:
Version 6.5: Augured Homecoming (also: Version 6.5, Patch 6.5, Version Luna VI, Luna VI, Song of the Welkin Moon: Rondo, Augured Homecoming update): Version Luna VI (numbered 6.5 on the wiki, with the Archon Quest subtitle "Song of the Welkin Moon: Rondo") was released on 2026-04-08, after Luna V. It added Linnea, the area Windrest Peak in northern Mondstadt and the sky realm Temple of Space. It had no Archon Quest.

Linnea's first Story Quest, the Alcyon Chapter Act I, is set in Nod-Krai. The world quest series "A Long Day in the Mountains" introduces Windrest Peak and the Temple of Space, which is reached from its Old Sanatorium Site.

Release: Released 2026-04-08. Previous: Luna V. Next: Luna VII.

New character: Linnea ("Augur of Wonders", 5-star Geo bow). New weapon: Golden Frostbound Oath (5-star bow). New areas: Windrest Peak and Temple of Space.

New content: Linnea. Alcyon Chapter Act I, "Up! Toward Homecoming Wings". World quests including the "A Long Day in the Mountains" series.

Other world quests: "Forest Boar Pauses for the Bloom", "Submerged Dragon, Soaring Phoenix" and "Winds Beneath the Tower of Silence". A new Temple of Space system, the Memory Core, accepts Memory Factors for rewards.

189.comment: Version 6.5: Augured Homecoming: Version 6.5 Windrest Peak
189.content: Windrest Peak is the northernmost part of Mondstadt, centred on the port town of Dornman Port, with Millhaven and the Old Sanatorium Site nearby. It is new in this version.

190.comment: Version 6.5: Augured Homecoming: Version 6.5 Temple of Space
190.content: The Temple of Space is an area in the sky above Windrest Peak, with its own map and exploration progress. It is unlocked through the world quest "The Wind Has Ceased" and entered from a marker at the Old Sanatorium Site. The wiki says it was created by Asmoday, called the Ruler of Space, as an exhibition hall that preserves the records of fallen civilisations.

191.comment: Version 6.5: Augured Homecoming: Version 6.5 Alcyon Chapter
191.content: "Up! Toward Homecoming Wings" is the first Act of Linnea's Story Quest, the Alcyon Chapter. It needs Adventure Rank 40 and "An Elegy for Faded Moonlight" from Song of the Welkin Moon, and the chapter is fully finished only after "A Nocturne of the Far North". Its quests are The Championship Begins, Twice Upon a Gaze and Tread the Right Path.

key: Version 6.6: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
Song of the Welkin Moon: Andante
Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana version
192.comment: Version 6.6: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
192.content:
Version 6.6: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana (also: Version 6.6, Version Luna VII, Luna VII, Song of the Welkin Moon: Andante, Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana version): Version Luna VII (numbered 6.6 on the wiki), "Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana", was released on 2026-05-20 and is subtitled "Song of the Welkin Moon: Andante". It added Acts IX and X of the Song of the Welkin Moon Archon Quest, which bring an Irminsul crisis to Sumeru and end it, and the playable characters Nicole and Prune, followed by Lohen in the second half. It opened no new area.

It follows Version 6.5 and precedes Version Luna VIII (6.7). The Archon Quest begins with the Traveler in Nod-Krai and then returns to Sumeru. The tagline describes an absurd dream in which a not-yet-decided future comes briefly into view.

Release: Released 2026-05-20, between Version Luna VI and Version Luna VIII.

Phase I (2026-05-20) had Angel's Reverie (Nicole and Prune) and Rubedo, of White Stone Born (Durin and Prune). Phase II (2026-06-09) had Frostedge Nocturne (Lohen) and Ancient Flame Ablaze (Mavuika).

Characters: Nicole ("Clamor Within", a 5-star Pyro catalyst user of the Hexenzirkel), Prune ("Childlike Dreams Cherished", a 4-star Anemo catalyst user) and Lohen ("Sharpened Arrowhead", a 5-star Cryo polearm user and Knights of Favonius vice captain) were added.

Nicole and Prune debuted on 2026-05-20, and Lohen on 2026-06-09. The wiki gives all three the Hexerei team bonus. Lohen's Story Quest is the Lepus Miles Chapter, Act I, "A Knight's Legacy".

Quests: Archon Quest: Song of the Welkin Moon Act IX, "As All Falls to Emptiness", and Act X, "Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana". World Quests were the Beyond Silver and Fine Gold chain (Nicole), the Witch's Homework series with "A Proposition Beyond Refutation", "Proof of Strength" and "The Role of a Guide...?", and "A Window Into the World".

key: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
Of Myriad Paths Flux and Dissolution
193.comment: Version 6.6: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana: Song of the Welkin Moon Acts IX and X
193.content: Act IX: an anomaly stops Irminsul from recording and processing information, Nahida takes over its work and collapses, and Sumeru's people evacuate to Caravan Ribat. Dottore's Fatui, the Jinn and a barrier around Sumeru complicate matters, while Nicole and Nefer arrive from Nod-Krai and the Traveler wakes Liloupar. Act X: the group overloads Irminsul through the Akasha System and Aaru, the Traveler brings Nahida the Pyro Gnosis from Natlan, and Nahida burns the corrupted tree. Dottore dies in the process.

194.comment: Version 6.6: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana: Version 6.6 events and gameplay
194.content: Limited events were Phantasmal Pals, Trials of the Brave Warrior and Kaleidoscopic Color Chase. Imaginarium Theater's first season from June 1 required Pyro, Cryo and Geo characters, and a new Spiral Abyss season from June 16 gave a 60 percent Cryo and Pyro damage bonus on Floor 11 and added the Blessing of the Abyssal Moon, Frost-Surging Moon. The domains Thorny Crown of the Mountain Wind and Binding Field of Universal Nirvana were added.

key: Song of the Welkin Moon: Scherzo
195.content:
Version 6.7: Sunny Summer Fontinalia (also: Version 6.7, Version Luna VIII, Luna VIII, Song of the Welkin Moon: Scherzo): Version Luna VIII (numbered 6.7 on the wiki), "Sunny Summer Fontinalia", was released on 2026-07-01 with the subtitle "Song of the Welkin Moon: Scherzo". It opened two new Nod-Krai areas, Dunanna Pit and the Frost Moon, added Sandrone as a playable five-star Cryo Claymore user, and brought a summer film-festival event in Fontaine. It had no Archon Quest.

It follows Version Luna VII and precedes Version 7.0. The headline story content was the Fontaine Story Quest Sunny Summer Fontinalia, the Frost Moon world-quest series Moon Gazing, and a long series of tea-party quests tied to Sandrone.

Release: Released 2026-07-01, between Version Luna VII and 7.0.

Phase I banners were Heavenlit Prophecy (a Witch's Revelation Lightrace Wish), To the Looking-Glass the Mademoiselle Said (Sandrone) and Starry Night's Whispers (Citlali). Phase II, from 2026-07-21, was Somnias a Luna (Columbina) and a Raiden Shogun rerun.

Areas: Dunanna Pit lies in Nod-Krai, close to Fontaine and east of Pohjola. The Frost Moon is reached by progressing the Moon Gazing quests and has three parts: the Lunar Highlands, the Moontide Sea and the Dark Side of the Moon. Outside Ungien's Circle its turbulent Archaeolune energy alters gravity, giving higher jumps and slower falls.

Quests: The Story Quest Sunny Summer Fontinalia has three acts: Should We Meet Again, Those We Have Lost and Those We Have Kept. World quests include the Moon Gazing series (Pioneers, Visitors From the Stars, Project Moongazer), Beneath the Lunar Sea, The Unmanned Vessel, Origin of the Sequence and Within the Sequence.

Events: The flagship event Sunny Summer Fontinalia ran from 2026-07-01 to 2026-08-11 around the Fontinalia Film Festival, with Charlotte as the character reward. Players run an aquarium through Operation Deep-Dive Treasure, Kaleido-Catch and Curio Ledger. Other events were Final Long-Range Sightlines, Dance Dance Easy-Breezy Disco and Ley Line Overflow.

key: Song of the Welkin Moon: Scherzo
196.comment: Version 6.7: Sunny Summer Fontinalia: Version Luna VIII
196.content: Luna VIII is the official name of what the wiki numbers 6.7. It released on 2026-07-01 and opened the Frost Moon and Dunanna Pit while adding Sandrone.

197.content: Stellar-Conduct is a Stellar Glimmer reaction between Cryo and Electro. It leaves a Starlight Prism lasting 7 seconds that sustains a Polestar Field, in which Cryo and Electro hits are recorded and buffs granted. This is a gameplay mechanic, not an in-world description.

198.content:
Version 7.0: Everwinter Without Mercy (also: Version 7.0, Genshin Impact 7.0): Version 7.0, "Everwinter Without Mercy", was released on 2026-08-12.
